The '''Umbaran hover tank''' was a high tech armored assault vehicle made by the [[Umbaran/Legends|Umbaran]] people and used by them during the [[Battle of Umbara/Legends|Battle of Umbara]].

==Description==
The Umbaran hover tank was a single-pilot vehicle built around an armored control pod flanked by twin conducting vanes that each housed an [[Electromagnetic plasma cannon/Legends|electromagnetic plasma cannon]] capable of decimating entire platoons of enemy troops with a single blast. The conducting vanes rotated and split open to serve as landing struts when the vehicle was powered down in a docked configuration.<ref name="encyclopedia" /> Although its cockpit was armored, its vanes were vulnerable to AT-RT fire.<ref name="dou" />

==History==
The [[Umbaran militia]] deployed these vehicles during the [[Battle of Umbara/Legends|Battle of Umbara]]. It caused many casualties to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] forces.<ref name="dou" /> Thanks to the Umbaran alliance with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], the tank fell into the hands of the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]].<ref name="umbarans" /> These tanks caused heavy casualties though some were destroyed by [[All Terrain Recon Transport/Legends|AT-RTs]].<ref name="dou">{{TCW|Darkness on Umbara}}</ref> A [[Unidentified Jedi Knight (Clone Wars)|Jedi Knight]] hijacked one of them and used them to destroy 4 [[Umbaran mobile heavy cannon/Legends|Umbaran mobile heavy cannons]].<ref name="CWA: Umbara">{{TCWA|Battle of Umbara}}</ref>
